pending_decision.question: 10000 training samples do not divide into groups of 64; how should the leftover micro-batch group be handled

options.error: refuse to run when not divisible (current default)
options.step: step once on the smaller group, effective batch becomes 16 for that step, gradients stay a mean
options.drop: discard the leftover group, 16 samples unused per epoch (48 across 3 epochs)

pending_decision.reason: silently using fewer samples or silently changing the effective batch would corrupt the reproducibility record

functions.resolve_device: errors instead of silently falling back to CPU when CUDA is requested but unavailable
functions.resolve_amp: returns (autocast kwargs, GradScaler); disables AMP explicitly on CPU and reports what was requested vs what took effect
